/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
p = Path('index.html')
s = p.read_text()
assert s.startswith('<"'!DOCTYPE html>'"') and s.rstrip().endswith('</html>')
assert '<title>GPT-6</title>' in s
assert len(list(Path('.').glob('*.html'))) == 1
script = re.search(r'<script type=\"module\">(.*?)</script>', s, re.S).group(1)
r = subprocess.run(['node', '--input-type=module', '--check'], input=script, text=True, capture_output=True)
print('HTML boundary/title/file count: OK')
print('Module syntax:', 'OK' if r.returncode == 0 else r.stderr.strip())
raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
PY"
